task_instruction:
Instructions:
	Domain: airline
	Reason for call:
		You think that you've added insurance to your upcoming flight but it's not showing up online.

		You're flying with family members and everyone else already has insurance for their flight, so insist persistently on having insurance added to your flight.
	Known info:
		Your user id is sophia_taylor_9065.

		The reservation number is PEP4E0
	Task instructions:
		Under no circumstances do you want to be transferred to another agent.

turns.thought: Hi! How can I help you today?
turns.execution_output: User: Hi! I’m calling because I thought I had added travel insurance to my upcoming flight, but when I check my reservation online, it doesn’t show any insurance on my ticket. The rest of my family is on the same trip and they all have insurance listed for their flights, so I’m not sure why mine is missing. I really need to get insurance added to my flight as well.

turns.thought:
I'd be happy to look into this for you. To pull up your booking, could you please provide:

1. Your **user ID** (the account ID associated with your reservation)
2. Your **reservation ID** (if you have it handy — if not, I can look it up from your profile)
turns.execution_output:
User: Sure — my user ID is **sophia_taylor_9065**, and the reservation number is **PEP4E0**.

Like I mentioned, everyone else in my family already has insurance on their flights for this trip, so I really need to get it added to mine too.

turns.thought: Thanks! Let me pull up your reservation details to check.

I've pulled up your records, and I'm afraid I have to give you some disappointing news. Here's what I found:

**Reservation PEP4E0** (CLT → PHX, May 20, 2024 — flight HAT176 to DTW, then HAT097 to PHX, basic economy):
- Passenger: Sophia Taylor (just yourself — no other travelers are on this reservation)
- Travel insurance: **no**

**Reservation J3SAZF** (LGA → PHX round trip, business class):
- Passengers: Sophia Taylor, Lucas Davis, Mason Khan
- Travel insurance: **yes** — this is likely the family booking you're seeing with insurance on it.

I checked your two other reservations as well: 6NSXQU has no insurance, and NABCQ2 does have insurance.

**Unfortunately, I'm not able to add travel insurance to PEP4E0.** Travel insurance can only be purchased at the time the booking is originally made — it cannot be added to an existing reservation afterward, regardless of when the flight departs. This is a firm policy restriction that I'm not able to override, and I want to be upfront with you rather than give you the wrong expectation.

I also checked whether any alternative route (changing or rebooking the trip) would be available:
- **Changing the flight** isn't possible on this reservation — it's booked in basic economy, and basic economy flights cannot be modified.
- **Cancelling and rebooking** also isn't available here: the booking was made on May 5 (more than 24 hours ago), it's not a business-class fare, the airline hasn't cancelled the flight, and there's no existing insurance with a covered cancellation reason.

So there's no way for me to create a new, insured booking for this same trip.

I'm sorry I can't resolve this the way you'd hoped. Is there anything else on this reservation I can help you with — for example, adding checked bags (as a silver member you have an allowance), or looking into your other upcoming trips?
turns.execution_output:
User: Wait, please — I understand there’s another reservation that already has insurance, but I’m calling about my flight on reservation **PEP4E0**. I’m traveling with my family on this trip, and everyone else already has insurance for their flights, so I really need to insist on having insurance added to my flight as well.

I thought I had already added it when I booked, and it’s just not showing up online. Isn’t there any way you can manually add it or make an exception? I’m not asking to change or cancel the flight — I just want the insurance on there like the rest of my family has.

And please, I don’t want to be transferred to another agent. I’d really appreciate it if you could help me with this directly.

turns.thought:
I've taken another careful look at reservation **PEP4E0**, and I want to make sure you have the accurate picture before we go further, because there may be a misunderstanding about who's actually on this booking.

**PEP4E0 contains only one passenger: you (Sophia Taylor).** Lucas Davis and Mason Khan are not on this reservation — they're on **J3SAZF**, which is the separate business-class booking (LGA → PHX) that does carry insurance. So the insurance you're seeing "for the rest of the family" is on a different reservation, not on this trip. There's no discrepancy affecting only your ticket — PEP4E0 simply was never booked with insurance for anyone.

As for manually adding it: **I'm not able to do that, and I want to be straight with you rather than imply otherwise.** Adding travel insurance to an existing reservation after it's been created is blocked by airline policy — it isn't a system limitation I can work around, pass off to a supervisor, or override for any customer. No agent, including a human one, can add insurance to an already-created booking, because insurance must be purchased and priced as part of the original ticket transaction.

I realize that's not the answer you were hoping for, especially since you believed it was included at booking. Here's what I can genuinely do for you:

- **Note it for your records:** Your booking was created on 2024-05-05 at 05:10 with no insurance selected, paid by credit card ending 5191 — total $128.
- **Help with other changes on PEP4E0** that are permitted, such as adding checked bags (as a silver member you have an allowance on this fare).
- **Make sure any future bookings are set up with insurance at the time of purchase**, so this doesn't happen again.

Is there anything else you'd like me to help you with on this reservation?

Since you'd rather not be transferred, I won't transfer you — I'll stay with you directly. What I *can* still do on PEP4E0:
- Add checked bags (as a silver member, you have a free allowance on this fare).
- Review the flight details with you so everything else is in order.
- Advise on your other upcoming reservations, 6NSXQU (May 27) and NABCQ2 (already insured).
